name: Republic of Acre (1899–1900)
description: A field divided diagonally from the upper fly to the lower hoist, yellow above and green below.
history: The flag of the Independent State of Acre proclaimed by the Spaniard Luis Gálvez at Puerto Alonso on 14 July 1899, decreed the following day; the republic was suppressed by Bolivia in March 1900. Gálvez's diagonal bicolour, without a star, is the ancestor of the present flag of the Brazilian state of Acre.

features.symbolism: green for the forest, yellow for its riches
